test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the famous festival game of Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Boat race**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vallam kali**

 
 
• In **Kerala, India**, there is a** famous traditional boat racing known as "Vallam Kali."** 
 
• **War canoes with paddles **are used in this style of canoe racing.
 
• It is primarily carried out in the** springtime during the Onam harvest celebration**.
 
• Vallam Kali features competitions for numerous varieties of **paddled longboats and "snake boats."**
 
• **The Nehru Trophy** costs each team roughly **6 lakh rupees**.
 
• The main event is the race of the **chundan vallam, or "snake boat," which is roughly 30-35 meters (100-120 feet) long and has 64 or 128 paddlers** aboard.
 
• The snake boat race, also known as Vallam Kali, is a **popular tourist destination**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other boat types that take part in the race include the **veppu vallam, vadakkanody vallam, kochu vallam, churulan vallam, iruttukuthy vallam, odi vallam, veppu vallam, and vadakkanody vallam**. 
 
• A well-known vallam kali competition called the Nehru Trophy Boat Race takes place in the** Punnamada Lake close to Alappuzha in Kerala, India**.
 
• **King Devanarayana of Chembakassery commissioned the construction of a war boat named Chundan Vallam **during a conflict in Kerala at the beginning of the 13th century between the feudal kingdoms of Kayamkulam and Chembakassery.
 
• The Malayalam poetic style known as **vanchipattu, or "boatsong," **is frequently used during vallam kali and other similar festivities.
